footer.description: A non-profit initiative bringing live performances to patients during hospital stays. Free for hospitals, artists, and families.

Home.description: See them smile, be moved, sing, learn — and yes, cry — again, sharing unforgettable moments with the people they love.

hero.imageAlt: A cellist performs for a group of patients and family members in a hospital common room, with a person in a wheelchair among the audience.

mission.title: One open slot in the schedule can be the best moment of the month.
mission.description: We don't replace treatment — we accompany it. We coordinate with each ward so music, theatre, or a workshop arrives without interrupting care, and so every performance means something to the person receiving it.
mission.imageAlt: An artist shows coloured paper cut-outs to a group of patients, a teenager, and a nurse gathered around a table covered in craft materials.

Help.title: How Vivetutiempo works
Help.intro: A quick guide to the process, for hospitals, artists, and families.

howItWorks.title: How a moment comes together
howItWorks.description: Four steps, one shared afternoon. Before any of it begins, an administrator validates every hospital and every artist; after that, each step is reviewed before it reaches a patient.

01.text: Open a slot in the ward's agenda — a date, a time, a place where patients could use some company.

02.text: Browse open slots and propose an activity: music, storytelling, magic, a workshop.

03.text: The same hospital reviews the proposals it received and confirms one. The moment becomes a scheduled event.

04.text: Patients and their families see what's coming up, and share how it went.

items.question: How are events and artists rated?
items.answer: In this MVP phase, Vivetutiempo doesn't calculate automatic event ratings. The star examples you see on the homepage are illustrative, not real data. Verified artist and event ratings are planned for a later phase.

items.question: What do a slot's age bands (audience) mean?
items.answer: Each slot a hospital publishes shows a rough age band — for example ages 0–5, 6–12, adults, or all ages — so artists can propose an activity suited to who'll attend.

items.question: How is patient location protected?
items.answer: Vivetutiempo never publishes patient personal data. A slot's ward or room is visible only to signed-in artists considering a proposal; it never appears in the public event listing. No patient's name, room number, or reason for admission is recorded on the platform at all.

About.title: A non-profit platform bringing live culture to the hospital bedside.
About.intro: Here we explain what Vivetutiempo is, who takes part, how privacy is protected, and why it's free. For a step-by-step of how to publish or propose, visit Help.

purpose.title: Our purpose
purpose.description: Long hospital stays isolate. Vivetutiempo exists so music, theatre, and workshops reach the ward without replacing clinical care, always coordinated with the hospital.

items.name: Patient and family

flow.title: The journey, at a glance
flow.description: A slot starts at the hospital, an artist proposes for it, and it becomes a public event. For the detail of each step, see Help.

validation.title: Validated profiles
validation.description: No hospital or artist can act on the platform until an admin reviews and approves their profile. That validation is what keeps Vivetutiempo safe and clinically sound.

dataStance.title: What data we publish, and what we don't
dataStance.description: We publish what's needed to find a hospital or an event: name, city, postal code, and, for hospitals, an approximate map location.
excluded: The exact room or ward where an event takes place
The content of proposals between hospitals and artists
Email addresses or internal database identifiers
Any visible link between a specific hospital and its events
dataStance.note: The hospital directory and the event listing are deliberately kept unlinked: seeing a hospital never reveals which events it has had, and seeing an event never reveals which hospital it happened at.

funding.title: Why it's free
funding.description: Vivetutiempo is a non-profit initiative. Hospitals, artists, and families pay nothing to take part; the project is sustained apart from any transaction between them.
